client: EDEN — Brand Identity for a Luxury Plant Shop
brief: The challenge was to design an identity for a plant shop that felt rooted in luxury and nature rather than typical eco-branding clichés. To solve this, the letter D in the wordmark was replaced with a monstera leaf silhouette, fusing type and botanical form into a single mark instead of pairing a logo icon with separate lettering. A high-contrast serif typeface was chosen over the rounded sans-serifs common in the plant space to signal heritage and quiet luxury, while a warm cream background paired with a deep olive green evokes sunlight through foliage without leaning on expected "plant-shop green." These decisions together produce a mark that's distinctive, legible at small scale, and communicates the brand's biophilic, sustainability-driven positioning through the logo itself.

details.label: Typography Detail
details.caption: The serif was chosen over trendy rounded sans-serifs to signal heritage and quiet luxury instead of generic eco-branding.

details.label: Grid / Layout
details.caption: The grid shows each letterform boxed to its own vertical column, with horizontal guides pinning the baseline and cap-height — keeping proportions, spacing, and the leaf-D substitution mathematically consistent and reproducible at any scale.

details.label: Special Element
details.caption: whole conecpt was centered around communicating Warmth, trust, and quiet luxury — the kind of calm, grounded feeling you get walking into a sunlit greenhouse.

client: Upwork project by Fairland RV Park
brief: A custom logo built around the nostalgia of classic American road trips and RV camping culture. The mark blends mid-century travel poster illustration with a modern, clean linework style — merging retro warmth with contemporary versatility. Reference points spanned vintage national park badges, 1960s trailer branding, and hand lettered roadside signage, synthesized into a single cohesive identity rather than a direct pastiche of any one influence. The result balances the comfort and familiarity of old-school RV travel with a mark that holds up on modern applications from vehicle decals to digital platforms.

details.label: Typography Detail
details.caption: A bold serif for "FAIRLAND RV PARK" gives it road-sign sturdiness and vintage credibility, paired with a loose, hand-lettered script for the tagline to keep it warm and personal  echoing hand-painted camp signage.
